technical_summary: Workload: chat + embeddings. Typical chat sessions: 8-16 tokens per turn, average length 120 tokens. Peak concurrent requests 700-1,200 across product. Target latency: p95 <120ms for canned responses, p95 <250ms for long-form outputs. Throughput target for Dedicated POC: sustained 500 rps with spikes to 1.5k. Need KV/prefix caching for multi-turn context. Preference for quantized model variants for CPU fallback and smaller GPU instances for canary. Tracing: requires distributed tracing hooks + per-request token cost breakdown in Console.
poc_plan: 3-week POC on Dedicated pool. Week 0: infra + VPC peering + secrets (KMS). Week 1: deploy primary model variant (redwood-veryfast-v1) and smaller fast variant (rv-fp16-compact) to dedicated pool. Week 2: run canary traffic 10-30% for 72 hours, measure latency/cost/error. Week 3: scale to 70% if stable; run regression checks on prompt set; final acceptance: p95 latency <150ms and error rate <1.5% while cost per 1M tokens falls within target band. Acceptance artifacts: trace reports, cost dashboard, eval diffs.
canary_and_fallback_details: Canary routing plan: start 10% traffic to Dedicated canary (us-east), rest to Hosted API baseline. Monitor key metrics: p95 latency, 5xx rate, model-quality drift (eval prompts). Canary escalation: hold if error rate >2% for 30m or p95 increase >40% vs baseline. Fallbacks: automatic routing to (a) hosted API same model, (b) hosted API smaller quantized variant, (c) cross-region Dedicated standby (eu-west) if region health degrades. Rollback criteria: sustained errors or quality regression on golden prompt set; rollback to last known-good deployment version. Operator flows: manual rollback via Console + automated route-policy if health-checks fail. Include tracing link header for Firefly transcripts and Jira tickets for any escalations.
